fusions.name: Unspooled Gust
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of loose arcana 5 tiles long, dealing 3 damage to everything in it, each with a 20% chance of [Exposed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wild Burst
fusions.desc: Hurls a bolt of arcana into the first enemy it meets for 26 damage, bursting for 80% of that on every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Ley Updraft
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 10 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Spellflight
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 9.5 tiles and deals 7 lightning damage. Once every 8 seconds.
